title: Full-Stack Engineer (Mobile / React Native Focus)
description:
Overview
We’re looking for a senior full-stack engineer with a strong mobile focus who has shipped
consumer mobile apps (iOS/Android) and can take a product from MVP → production →
scale. This person should have a high-ownership mindset, move fast, communicate clearly,
and thrive working closely with founders/creators.
Must-Haves
* Senior full-stack experience in consumer tech, with shipped mobile apps on iOS/Android (ideally React Native; Swift/Kotlin experience is a plus).
* Strong backend experience (e.g., Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or similar), including:
○API design and system architecture fundamentals databases (SQL/NoSQL)
○integrations with payments, analytics, and social features (auth, sharing, feeds, etc.)
Proven ability to deliver in fast-moving startup environments and own work
end-to-end.
Track record of building high-engagement, polished consumer products (not primarily
internal tools).
Strong “builder energy”: proactive, collaborative, clear communicator, moves with
urgency, and takes ownership.


Nice-to-Haves
* Experience with growth loops, retention, and mobile performance optimization (startup time, crash rate, bundle size, offline, etc.).
* Worked on products that reached meaningful consumer scale (clear traction/metrics).

title: Full Stack Engineer - Oracle
description:
About the Company
This company builds technology that makes financial markets safer, more transparent, and more accessible for all. As the first automated, on-chain economic security system, it helps leading crypto protocols optimize risk management, safeguard user funds, and unlock capital efficiency, guided by the belief that better data leads to better decisions.


The team analyzes protocol mechanics and scenario implications using world-class custom EVM simulations to provide actionable insights. Leading protocols, including PayPal, Uniswap, Aave, GMX, dYdX, Venus, and Jupiter, trust the platform to manage and secure billions of dollars in assets.


Company Values
Be ready to join a team that works hard and genuinely cares about each other.
* Security First: Protecting user funds is the highest priority.
* Innovation at Speed: The team experiments and iterates quickly to stay ahead of the market.
* Collaboration & Ownership: Small, high-impact teams that own their work end-to-end.
* Transparency: Clear communication, inside and outside the company.
* Long-Term Impact: Focus on sustainable growth over short-term wins.


About the Role
As a Full Stack Engineer (Oracle), you'll design and build the Oracle infrastructure and data-driven systems that power protocol risk insights across multiple blockchains. Reporting to the Oracle Lead and collaborating closely with research and protocol teams, you'll transform complex DeFi data into reliable, production-grade tools that help safeguard billions of dollars in on-chain assets.


About You
* You're a senior full-stack engineer who enjoys owning projects from concept to production.
* You have deep expertise in modern backend and frontend systems and are comfortable working across data pipelines, APIs, and user-facing interfaces.
* You're energized by collaborating with research and protocol teams, turning complex DeFi mechanics into intuitive, data-rich dashboards and tools.
* You enjoy breaking down ambiguous problems, proposing technical solutions, and continuously improving systems that directly impact user trust and protocol security.
What You'll Do
As a Full Stack Engineer (Oracle), you will:
* Take full ownership of projects, from breaking down high-level goals to driving execution end-to-end
* Build and maintain oracle infrastructure that powers multiple data feeds across various blockchains
* Design and develop data-driven dashboards and tools to support protocol risk analysis
* Design, build, and operate distributed backend systems in production environments
* Partner closely with research and protocol teams to deeply understand DeFi mechanisms and surface insights through intuitive interfaces
* Act as a technical owner and advocate for code quality, maintainability, and scalability
* Identify product opportunities and technical improvements across the platform
* Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver high-quality, production-grade systems


Required Skills
* 8+ years of professional experience in full-stack development
* Strong experience with modern backend technologies such as Node.js and Python
* Hands-on experience with Python, Go, Solidity, and Rust
* Proven, hands-on experience building production systems in DeFi and blockchain environments
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage projects and deliver production-grade features
* Comfortable working in dynamic, high-ownership environments with shifting priorities
* Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for building high-quality engineering solutions
* Excellent communication skills in a remote, cross-functional setting


Bonus Points
* Experience designing, building, and operating cloud-native services (AWS and/or GCP)
* Strong frontend engineering fundamentals, including performance, accessibility, and testing
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps workflows


Compensation & Benefits
Competitive salary: $144,000 – $164,000 USD/year, based on experience

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
The team streamlines real estate deal processes, from data to documents. Their team powers the industry that powers cities by bringing structure to complex workflows and clarity to high-stakes decisions.


If you’re excited about joining a team that’s innovating an industry and winning clients, this is the place for you. You’ll find an environment where your ideas are valued and expected, your expertise is respected, and your work makes a real impact.


Here, engineers are trusted owners. They operate autonomously and with high standards and care for the product, customers, and each other. They’re a lean, agile team focused on scalable systems, clean APIs, and infrastructure that supports real-world transactions.


You’ll work cross-functionally with product, success, and fellow engineers. No silos, no ego. Just smart people building things that last.




Core Values
* No Bad Ideas: Brainstorm with curiosity and openness.
* Belief in Better: Data and software are transforming real estate.
* Built for the Long Term: Prioritizing sustainability.
* Customers Are Partners: Treating them as part of the team.
* Feedback Driven: Give and receive it often and respectfully.
* Be Kind: Kindness is an asset.




Core Stack
* Angular 17 - framework used to build dynamic, scalable frontend interfaces.
* TypeScript — strongly typed JavaScript used to ensure maintainable and predictable frontend code.
* REST APIs —  used to connect the frontend application with backend services.
* State Management Libraries — tools used to manage and synchronize application state across complex UI components.
* Jest — testing framework used to create unit tests and ensure code reliability and stability.


What You’ll Do
* Identify issues with front-end code and rectify them to remove bugs
* Create unit tests to ensure the code is functioning as expected
* Audit code to identify bottlenecks of performance and fix them
* Design and implement visually aesthetic user interfaces
* Ensure front-end code can query APIs
* Create documentation as needed


Technical Requirements
* 5+ Years of experience with Angular 17+ framework and Typescript.
* Experience with state management libraries
* Experience with unit tests using Jest
* Some knowledge of UX/UI


Engineering Mindset
* Writes clean, maintainable code
* Writes clean, maintainable frontend code and prioritizes readability and long-term sustainability.
* Balances delivery speed with thoughtful, reusable implementation
* Values collaboration, feedback, and kindness


Communication & Culture Fit
* Fluent in English (B2+)
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment
* Excited to share and discuss ideas in an open, respectful culture
* Comfortable working with uncertainty and evolving requirements.
* Committed to long-term team and product success


Compensation & Benefits
* Flexible paid time off
* $60,000/yr to $75,000/yr
* MacBook Pro M5 supplied by the company
* English Classes and premium subscriptions
* Accounting and Legal setup advisory (for PJ)
* Dedicated career mentor for ongoing support
* Direct deposit into your account every two weeks
* The company is led by a successful technical CEO
* Trip to the USA to hang out with your team (Visa included)
